sloka: न कालस्यातिभारो ऽस्ति कृतान्तश्च सुदुर्जयः ।यत्र रामः सह भ्रात्रा शेते युधि निपातितः ।। ६.४८.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: na kālasyātibhāro 'sti kṛtāntaśca sudurjayaḥ ।yatra rāmaḥ saha bhrātrā śete yudhi nipātitaḥ ।। 6.48.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "Rama along with Lakshmana has fallen in the battlefield. Time spirit is too heavy and capable of doing anything, so difficult to conquer."
